requirements.title: Minimum age 18
requirements.evidence: Verify age from an identity record; record a secure evidence reference.

requirements.title: Current driver license
requirements.evidence: Retain a copy of the current valid license; verify expiration and applicable driving privileges.

requirements.title: Motor vehicle record review
requirements.evidence: Initial MVR no more than 90 days old; repeat annually. Review the last three years against the form's limit of two chargeable accidents or two moving violations, and confirm no suspension or revocation for moving violations in the preceding five years.

requirements.title: Pre-employment drug screening
requirements.evidence: Retain drug test results, including for existing employees before Access2Care work. DOT testing applies when required by local regulation or requested by Access2Care. For a test older than 180 days with continuous employment, retain the no-break-in-employment attestation and provide results as required.

requirements.title: National background review
requirements.evidence: Initial check no more than 90 days old before services; repeat annually. Review the seven-year disqualifying-offense criteria in the source form (financial misconduct, elder/patient/child abuse, domestic violence, criminal sexual conduct, controlled-substance/drug and weapons offenses). Record vendor approval if not Occuscreen, or the permitted government-check attestation.

requirements.title: CPR training
requirements.evidence: Retain proof of completed CPR training; renew every two years or earlier if the credential expires.

requirements.title: Wheelchair securement and lift operation
requirements.evidence: Provider-delivered tie-down and lift-operation training when applicable. Retain training and practical competency records. Document the reason if not applicable.

requirements.title: HIPAA training
requirements.evidence: Retain training completion evidence. This form does not specify a renewal interval; apply any additional company or contract schedule separately.

requirements.title: Passenger assistance training
requirements.evidence: Retain proof of completed passenger assistance training; renew every two years.

requirements.title: General compliance and fraud, waste and abuse
requirements.evidence: Retain completed training or an accepted training attestation. Initial proof is due within 30 days of initial credentialing; renew annually.

requirements.title: Code of Conduct attestation
requirements.evidence: Retain the signed acknowledgment for the assigned Code of Conduct. Initial proof is due within 30 days of initial credentialing; renew annually.

requirements.title: First Aid training or accepted license
requirements.evidence: Retain training proof with two-year renewal, or a current EMT/Paramedic or similar qualifying license accepted by the form. Use the earlier applicable expiration.

requirements.title: Defensive driving training
requirements.evidence: Retain proof of completed defensive driving training; this form specifies a one-time requirement.

requirements.title: Physical and mental fitness to drive
requirements.evidence: Verify ability to drive and record the fitness determination or secure evidence reference. Do not place medical diagnoses in this checklist.

requirements.title: English communication
requirements.evidence: Document verification that the driver can communicate in English.

requirements.title: No tobacco in vehicles or near members
requirements.evidence: Retain acknowledgment of the rule prohibiting tobacco in the vehicle or in the presence of Access2Care members.

requirements.title: No texting or personal phone entertainment
requirements.evidence: Retain acknowledgment of the rule prohibiting texting or personal cell-phone entertainment while transporting Access2Care members.

requirements.title: Roster supplied for exclusion checks
requirements.evidence: Provide the roster before services and update it whenever drivers are added or removed. The form requests legal name matching the license, SSN, license number/state/expiration, birth date, hire date and add/delete status. Keep the roster in restricted storage and transmit through the approved credentialing channel. Record delivery evidence here, not SSNs.

requirements.title: Audit evidence available
requirements.evidence: Maintain retrievable supporting records for focused or random credentialing audits. Acknowledge the form's corrective-action and contract-termination consequences for unsupported compliance.

requirements.title: Annual organization attestation
requirements.evidence: After supporting records are verified, an authorized representative reviews and submits the provider attestation; retain the submission receipt and renew annually.
